title: Deep CFR physical-v6 readiness audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The existing Deep CFR core may be algorithmically functional on Leduc, but its HUNL game/export wiring is not yet contract-compatible with exact 200bb physical-v6 and therefore should not receive a large training budget until explicit parity gates pass.
material_change: Add a deterministic, no-training-hand readiness audit comparing Deep CFR game/action/export surfaces with physical-v6 and run a cheap exact tabular Leduc convergence control.
baseline: No prior logged Deep CFR HUNL evidence; physical-v6 contract is integer-chip 200bb, no raise cap, nine fixed action slots.
notes: Readiness audit only; do not train HUNL if any physical contract gate fails.

The preregistered 200-iteration tabular control ended at 165.3158 mbb/game after a nonmonotone 100-to-200 segment; extend the no-HUNL-hand control to 1000 iterations to distinguish insufficient small-game budget from a broken regret core.

The first direct launch exposed a repository-root import bootstrap omission before the audit ran; the same preregistered command succeeded after adding only SCRIPTS_ROOT to sys.path. No poker hands or partial result artifact were produced by the failed launch.

result.summary: Exact audit generated zero HUNL training/evaluation hands. Tabular Leduc converged to 26.1112 mbb/game at 1000 iterations, but all five physical-HUNL gates failed: trainer and CLI omit full_200bb, initial action slots differ, postflop re-raises are blocked, and nine-action checkpoints cannot load into the hardcoded six-action exporter.
result.conclusion: The regret core is viable enough to justify an exact-v6 adapter experiment, but the existing HUNL trainer cannot train or export the target physical-v6 game without silently changing the game or failing on shapes.
result.next_step: Implement and parity-test a minimal external-sampling traversal adapter directly over ChipState and policy_contract_v6.action_table; require exact transition/action/payoff gates plus a tiny bounded traversal smoke before any larger neural regret training.
